name: stakeholder-brief
summary: Explain the system's state to people who do not work in it, in their terms, with the real numbers.

when: someone outside the team needs to understand what the system is doing
investment or headcount is being discussed
not: telling engineers what changed in a release

steps: Run system-health FIRST and use its numbers. A brief written from impressions is the thing that destroys credibility the first time someone checks one.
Translate each measure into a consequence they already care about: time, risk, or consistency across the products they see.
Include what is going badly. A brief with no bad news is read as marketing and discounted entirely, including the good news.
Ask for one thing. A brief with four asks gets none of them.
output: State, trend, what is going badly, and one ask.
done: every number traces to a measured gate
at least one genuine problem is stated
